name: qfd_bl_lane_cs-cs1-COMMIT
purpose: Qwen3-8B ROM TP8 qfd_sp_band_lanes as a leaf partition: the one-lane master (16 per slot, 48 on the die).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_bl_lane u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_band_lanes_slots.sv rtl/qwen_sys/lane_band_20261008/ot_qfd_band_lanes.sv rtl/hdc/ot_qwen_me_spine_h_w12.sv rtl/hdc/ot_qwen_w12_matvec.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat_nr.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_bl_lane_cs/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_bl_lane_cs/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_bl_lane_cs --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_bl_lane --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: 37 routes of the flat ot_qfd_band_lanes (NL 16: 128,608 flops + 64 SRAMs on one root; q4 quarters: 32,080 flops) failed: hold repair flooded (224k-227k endpoints), setup -2,294 ps post-CTS, S/M5 pin density 20.8 b/um; one M8-era q4 closed (+7.52 / +0.26) and its M5 re-route stalled in CTS hold repair.  The slot is now a LEAF PARTITION by lane: ONE hardened one-lane master qfd_bl_lane (8,038 flops + 4 SRAM 128x256, own root, 194.4 x 280.8, M5 cap, recipe 2) x 16, wires only above it; the band <-> tree-top relay count is a strap (lnk) so the one view serves any die placement of the links. Compact TritonCTS measured335.2ps/spread87.6ps remains boundary-spread defect. Use balanced preplaced tree on the same compact2x2 macro layout; prior tall balanced tree measured spread29.1 but475.9ps insertion, so compact tree removes long trunk as well.
